name: Takaboshi Kazuna
source:
Another main heroine. Kazuna is the mayor of Forsyse and the caretaker of [url=/c1039]Yoshikazu[/url] and [url=/c1040]Shizuku[/url]. Served as the explanation person during the first half of the story. Her power is telekinesis…in a large scale. Her personality is quite light-hearted, and she is the one who names all the special moves for other people’s abilities. 

[Edited from [url=http://whatistomato.wordpress.com/2010/07/09/a-tribute-to-evolution/]Warum's review[/url].]
